newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Car report disappoints Mitsubishi Australia.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Car report disappoints Mitsubishi Australia.

text.p: Mitsubishi Motors Australia Ltd managing director Mike Quinn said on Friday he was disappointed but not surprised at the direction of the Industry Commission's draft report on assistance to the automotive industry.

"I am very disappointed, but not surprised at the direction of the Commission's majority report which appears to ignore the government's expressed policy of encouraging 'the development of a sustainable, prosperous and internationally competitive automotive manufacturing industry'," Quinn said in a statement. The company is a unit of Mitsubishi Motors Corp.
